summary.name: DataRobot
summary.one_liner: DataRobot is an enterprise platform for building, running, and governing AI agents across their lifecycle.
use_cases: deploying agents to edge, cloud, or on-prem
controlling agent and user access to data and APIs
forecasting with AI across data sources
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an agent platform split into three lifecycle areas: building, operating, and governing agents. Building covers customizable blueprints, built-in integrations, choice of LLMs and embeddings, and tuning the balance between accuracy, latency, and cost. Operating covers dynamic compute orchestration for deploying agents at edge, cloud, or on-prem, real-time quality monitoring, and authentication of agents and users. Governing covers tracking assets and activity, enforceable controls such as access and approvals, and testing frameworks with automated audit documentation. The page also lists customer ROI claims and analyst recognitions, but gives no technical specifics beyond these.
notable: Covers the full agent lifecycle: build, operate, and govern
Deploys agents to edge, cloud, or on-prem environments
Listed as part of the NVIDIA Enterprise AI Factory reference design (per customer quote)
Analyst recognition in Gartner Magic Quadrant for DSML Platforms and MarketScapes for AI Governance and MLOps
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page
Customer ROI figures are testimonials and are not independently verified
